title: What database should we add?
question: The app already uses on-device SQLite. What does your teacher want?

options.label: Document the existing SQLite DB
options.thesis: Keep local SQLite; add schema docs, ERD, and maybe sample SQL for the class report.
options.viewport: No app rewrite — schema diagram and table docs for books, users, borrows.
options.risk: Teacher may want a server DB instead of documentation only.

options.label: MySQL / MariaDB (school server)
options.thesis: Move or sync library data to a MySQL database with a small API (common school setup).
options.viewport: App talks to a backend; login and books live in MySQL.
options.risk: Needs hosting, network, and more setup than local SQLite.

options.label: Firebase / cloud database
options.thesis: Use Firebase Auth + Firestore (or similar) so data syncs online.
options.viewport: Accounts and loans in the cloud; works across devices when online.
options.risk: Changes offline-first product positioning; needs Google project setup.

options.label: Not sure — show me options for class
options.thesis: Explain what we already have and a short recommendation for a school project.
options.viewport: Chat summary comparing SQLite vs MySQL vs Firebase for this app.
options.risk: We wait on a clear pick before coding.
